subject: ophthalmology
title: PRK, SMILE, Aphakia and Pseudophakia

steps.tx: **PRK** ablates corneal surface after epithelial removal without a stromal flap, trading slower painful recovery and haze risk for no flap complications and preserved biomechanics in thinner corneas. Athletes and military candidates often prefer surface ablation for flap displacement safety. Antimetabolite application during surgery reduces haze formation in higher corrections according to protocol.
steps.say: Surface ablation without flap gives biomechanical preservation in thinner corneas during refractive surgery. Slower painful recovery gives the trade against flap procedures for candidates. Haze prophylaxis is companion to higher corrections in protocols.

vis.alt: Surgical steps of photorefractive keratectomy, from epithelial debridement to surface excimer laser photoablation of the cornea.
vis.caption: Photorefractive keratectomy is shown in sequence: corneal epithelium removed, then excimer laser photoablation reshaping the exposed surface. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **SMILE** extracts a stromal lenticule through a small incision without large flap, preserving anterior corneal nerves and biomechanics more than flap surgery while correcting myopic astigmatism within approved ranges. Hypermetropic treatment and retreatment flexibility lag flap procedures in availability. Small incision healing gives faster surface recovery than surface ablation with less dry eye in comparative teaching.
steps.say: Lenticule extraction through a small incision gives nerve preservation advantages during refractive surgery. Myopic correction range gives current availability limits for the technique. Dry eye reduction gives comparative benefit after healing.

steps.tx: **Aphakia** is absence of crystalline lens after congenital failure, dislocation removal or surgery without implant, producing high hypermetropia, loss of accommodation and image magnification problems with spectacle correction. Aphakic spectacles magnify about a quarter, ring scotoma and pincushion distortion limiting tolerance, especially unilateral. Contact or secondary implant correction therefore dominates modern aphakia rehabilitation in children and adults.
steps.say: Lens absence gives high hypermetropia with accommodation loss after surgery. Spectacle magnification gives tolerance limits in unilateral cases. Contact or implant correction gives modern rehabilitation.

steps.tx: The space this lens occupies explains both its appeal and its complications. A posterior chamber **phakic intraocular lens** sits behind the iris and vaults over the natural crystalline lens, correcting high refractive error without removing corneal tissue or the lens itself. Vault height is the measurement that matters: too low risks cataract from touch, too high risks angle crowding and pressure rise. Sizing from anterior segment imaging therefore decides safety before surgery begins.
steps.say: A phakic intraocular lens vaults over the natural lens behind the iris. Vault too low risks cataract, too high risks angle crowding, so sizing decides safety.

vis.alt: Cross section diagram of the anterior segment showing a posterior chamber phakic intraocular lens vaulted over the crystalline lens.
vis.caption: A phakic intraocular lens is shown vaulted above the crystalline lens in the posterior chamber. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Pseudophakia** is lens replaced by intraocular implant, restoring focus without accommodation in monofocal designs that set distance or near by power choice. Multifocal and extended depth designs split light for range at contrast and glare cost needing candidate selection. Posterior capsule opacification later clouds the retained capsule behind any implant design, treated by laser capsulotomy in the cataract batch.
steps.say: Implant replacement gives focus without accommodation in monofocal designs typically. Multifocal splitting gives range at contrast cost needing selection. Capsule opacification gives later laser treatment need.

steps.tx: Procedure selection by corneal thickness, error size, occupation trauma risk, dry eye and age gives the refractive surgery consultation structure. Thin corneas favour surface or lenticule or lens routes, extreme errors favour lens routes, contact sport favours no flap routes. **Expectation counselling** on night glare, regression and enhancement possibility accompanies every route equally.
steps.say: Thickness, error and occupation together give procedure selection structure in consultation. Thin corneas give surface or lens route preference. Expectation counselling accompanies every route.

steps.tx: Paediatric aphakia rehabilitation races visual development: early optical correction with contact lenses and amblyopia occlusion decides adult acuity more than surgical elegance. Implant timing in infants balances inflammatory and glaucoma risk against optical benefits, staged by age in specialist centres. **Critical period** urgency from anisometropia lesson applies here with maximal force.
steps.say: Early optical correction gives amblyopia prevention in paediatric aphakia rehabilitation races. Implant timing gives balance of risk against benefit by age. Critical period urgency is maximal here.

steps.tx: Enhancement and regression teaching: undercorrection may enhance after stability, overcorrection in myopes trades distance for near unexpectedly, and regression toward original error follows epithelial and stromal remodelling variably. Enhancement needs residual bed recalculation, never automatic repeat ablation. **Stability documentation** before enhancement repeats the primary surgery gate without exception.
steps.say: Stable undercorrection gives enhancement possibility after recalculation of residual bed surgically. Regression follows remodelling variability after corneal procedures in patients. Stability documentation gives gate repetition before enhancement always.

steps.tx: Anchors close the module: surface ablation has no flap, lenticule extraction uses a small incision, aphakia needs high plus correction, and pseudophakia focuses by implant power. Children race critical periods for acuity, adults choose procedures by cornea and lifestyle, and nobody escapes presbyopia biology. **Residual bed** recalculation guards both primary and enhancement ablations equally in safe practice.
steps.say: Surface, lenticule and lens states together give refractive surgery organisation completely for examinations. Childhood timing gives acuity outcomes in aphakia rehabilitation races. Residual recalculation gives enhancement safety in all cases.

cards.b: PRK: no flap and biomechanics preserved, but painful slow recovery and haze risk.
About quarter magnification, ring scotoma and pincushion distortion; contacts or implant preferred.
Lenticule extraction through small incision, nerves and biomechanics preserved, myopic range.
